Live-asset measurements of the UR5e + Robotiq 2F-85 used by frigidaire/tests/test_robot_conventions.py
(plan plans/2026-09-29-easy-s0.md, Phase 0.5; decisions D7 and D12).

conventions.json (written by frigidaire/scripts/setup/frigidaire_robot_conventions_fixture.py) is a TRIMMED copy of artifacts/p0_conventions/conventions.json, written on 2026-09-29 by
frigidaire/scripts/setup/frigidaire_robot_conventions.py (Kit, Isaac Sim 4.5.0) -- its "source" block holds the
sha256 of the full file. The copy keeps every measured value and drops only the per-step trajectories and the
contact-pair lists. It is an input only: to refresh it, re-run the Kit script with a new --run-id and copy the
trimmed result here (never edit values by hand).
